welcome_back:
🌍 *EARTH SONIFICATION BOT*
_NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026_

✨ *“Don't just see Earth's data — hear it.”*

Our planet is constantly changing: temperature rises, sea level shifts, clouds move across the atmosphere. This bot fetches real-time Earth data from NASA & open data providers and converts it into *musical parameters and sounds*!

🎯 *Core Features:*
🌡 *Temperature* — Pitch height maps directly to heat levels
🌊 *Sea Level* — Ascending Glissando tone maps to rising sea trends
☁️ *Cloud Cover* — Density maps to atmospheric chords & rhythm
🌍 *Earth Sound* — Complete Earth Symphony combining all parameters

👇 _Select one of the options below:_

help_text:
🤖 *Available Commands:*
• `/start` — Restart bot & open main menu
• `/temperature` — Temperature metrics & pitch sonification audio
• `/sea_level` — Sea level trend & glissando sweep audio
• `/clouds` — Cloud cover & ambient pad audio
• `/data` — Combined Earth data overview
• `/earth_sound` — Master Earth Symphony
• `/location` — Change active location
• `/language` — Switch language (UZ/RU/EN)
• `/about` — NASA Space Apps context & science
• `/help` — Help manual
about_text:
🌌 *STORYTELLING CONCEPT:*
_“Don't just see Earth's data — hear it.”_

We usually see planetary changes through numbers and charts. But human hearing is uniquely capable of feeling subtle pitch movements and rich harmonies.

🔬 *SCIENTIFIC & MUSICAL MAPPING:*
1. *Data Acquisition:* Real-time NASA POWER, Sentinel-6/Jason-3 Altimetry, and Open-Meteo APIs.
2. *DSP Synthesis:* Physical data is mapped to musical harmonic frequencies (Hz).
3. *Polyphony:* Each dataset acts as a distinct track in a master Earth Symphony.
